name: Pedro Javier González
description: '''Pedro Javier González García''' (born 1962) is a Spanish guitarist, composer, and record producer.  He has produced and collaborated with [[El Último de la Fila]], [[Joan Manuel Serrat]], [[Manolo García]] and [[María del Mar Bonet]], [[Victoria de los Ángeles]], and [[Angelo Branduardi]]. He has also performed at festivals with others such as [[B.B. King]], [[John McLaughlin (musician)|John McLaughlin]], [[Pat Metheny]], [[Paco de Lucía]], [[John Williams]], [[Tommy Emmanuel]], and [[Tomatito]]. He is noted for his ability to perform popular standards in a flamenco jazz style.
